$comment: FIXTURE, never a real release manifest. It encodes the loophole that the ABSENCE RECORD opens
if it is left unguarded. A release manifest must carry an entry for every named artefact even
when that artefact was not produced, because an OMITTED artefact reads as satisfied. But once
such an entry exists it carries a digest, and a digest is a binding target: a lane could name
it and claim PASSED, thereby claiming to have tested bytes that were never built.
tooling/verify-release.mjs MUST reject this with a message naming the absence:
a lane cannot have tested bytes that were never built.
